resources.string:
Press volume up and volume down together to run adb screenshot. It is saved to your gallery (DCIM/Screenshots) and a notification appears.

Requires:
1. Shizuku running and granted to this app
2. The "adb screenshot" accessibility service turned on

Press volume up and volume down together to run adb screenshot without the volume slider in it. Single volume presses are handled by this service (about 0.15 s delay). If the system volume-key accessibility shortcut is set up, the system intercepts the combination first and this feature cannot trigger.
Saved to gallery. Tap to open
